persistent_context.critical_alert: CRITICAL WIND: sustained 41 mph, gusting 52 mph — dome closure enforced

content.heading: Night Operations
status_grid: Telescope: PARKED — waiting for safe wind
content.current_target: M42 Orion Nebula — paused — 3 of 8 exposures complete
next_two_events: 02:40 UTC — begin NGC 2024 if conditions recover

layout_intent.desktop: Persistent left navigation; alert across the top; status cards in a three-column grid; current target and next events side by side.
layout_intent.narrow: Top navigation becomes a compact menu; alert remains pinned; status cards, target, and events stack in reading order.

content.heading: Ranked Target Queue
rows: 1 | M42 | Emission nebula | Critical | 22:10–01:35 local | 42 min | Paused
2 | NGC 2024 | Nebula | High | 22:35–02:10 local | 28 min | Ready
3 | M31 | Galaxy | Normal | 23:20–03:50 local | 55 min | Queued
view_states: Empty result: No targets match these filters

layout_intent.desktop: Search and filters above a full-width sortable table.
layout_intent.narrow: Controls collapse into a filter drawer; each row becomes a ranked card with all seven fields.

content.heading: M42 Orion Nebula
content.notes: Resume after the wind interlock clears. Keep the guide star selected during the filter change.
view_states: Warning: visibility window closes in 48 minutes

layout_intent.desktop: Breadcrumb and actions remain visible above a two-column detail and finder layout; exposure sequence and notes span the width below.
layout_intent.narrow: Breadcrumb, summary, finder placeholder, facts, sequence, notes, and actions stack; primary action stays visible.

current: 22:14 local — M42 exposure sequence — paused by wind interlock

layout_intent.desktop: Vertical time rail with completed, current, and upcoming groups visible together.
layout_intent.narrow: Single-column cards retain group labels, status, delay, and time.

content.heading: Systems Status
systems: Telescope — HEALTHY — parked, tracking drive ready
Dome — WARNING — closed by high-wind interlock
Camera — OFFLINE — cooling controller connection lost
Weather station — WARNING — critical wind readings
troubleshooting_panel: Camera: verify controller power and network link

layout_intent.desktop: Five status cards in a responsive grid with a persistent troubleshooting panel on the right.
layout_intent.narrow: Status cards stack; troubleshooting becomes an expandable panel below the offline card.

content.heading: Shift Handoff
completed_observations: M42 — 3 luminance exposures captured before pause
next_shift_priorities: Confirm safe wind before opening dome

layout_intent.desktop: Three summary panels appear side by side with Download handoff in the page header.
layout_intent.narrow: Summary panels stack in shift order; Download handoff remains a full-width action.
